answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. An attacker must incur the economic delta of these scorched assets, effectively pricing their malicious influence at the summit of their capital reserves. This barrier ensures that even a plume of generated identities cannot gain network dominance without a prohibitively high financial expenditure, thereby forcing attackers to internalize the cost of their own systemic disruption.
